      "observations": [
        "All 493 owned diff lines across six paths were read, including all deleted native authentication and forget code. nsIMsgNewsFolder removes public getAuthenticationCredentials/forgetAuthenticationCredentials and exposes readonly urlForSignon. JS now owns credential lookup, prompt formatting and removal. The native URL getter still distinguishes server-wide single signon from a group URI, applies SSL-port handling and trims a trailing slash; the obsolete ref-setting helper branch is removed.",
        "The original JS queries use the entire signon URL as both origin and httpRealm. The accepted lookup, retry-removal and server-forget paths later use Services.io.newURI(signonUrl).prePath for origin while keeping the full signonUrl realm. No paired login-manager matching/normalization implementation was read, so this exact input difference is not claimed as a proven fix or equivalence.",
        "The async credential helper preloads the first matching login when either field is missing, formats server/group prompt strings with awaited formatValue and calls the synchronous prompt. Cancellation clears both folder fields. Its final username && password result is consumed by truthiness, not as a strict Boolean. The outer _actionAuthUser still calls the helper only when groupUsername is absent; forcePrompt is not an unconditional prompt guarantee outside that gate.",
        "The newly async authentication-result action waits for removal before clearing cached folder credentials and starting its retry. Both the original and accepted response dispatcher call _nextAction without await; the synchronous catch cannot catch a later rejected Promise. The retry also starts _actionAuthUser without awaiting it. The public server forgetPassword interface remains synchronous via per-folder settlement waits, whose rejection does not implement successful cache clearing. No network/rejection path ran.",
        "All three actual review inlines were read. The owned source adopts both requested @param declarations and awaited localization despite unchanged Not Done badges. The remaining IDL intro still tells consumers to call removed getAuthenticationCredentials, so it no longer describes an available public method. Keep this local documentation mismatch separate from the useful new urlForSignon comment.",
        "The only test change adds run-sequentially for test_xover. Its actual unchanged setup and server.start both use NNTP_PORT, supporting the scoped scheduling reason. No new behavioral assertion or test body is added. Shared full primary is reused once across 5115–5117, and sparse approval/remote completion remain historical rather than fresh NNTP or test results.",
        "All three actual own-review inlines are reconciled against the source. Both requested parameter docs and async localization are adopted in the owned code, despite Not Done badges. Sparse acceptance and historical remote-build completion do not prove a NNTP or test result.",
        "The complete primary is reused from B's one full 5115–5117 family read, preserving original A collector scope/time. Its initial JS stack, later Rust reopening and reported Try failure are separate phases. The required review gaps for 5115 do not transfer to this independently complete own review."
